items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: Even John Vien played with him, too. John Vien played with him after?

ctx.x: Yeah. Jimmy Phillips. Or Lewis was the clarinet.

Yeah. That's the way that was. Then Vien, Vien taking his place after that. Well, you remember when D.D. played with? D.D. Yeah, D.D. Channel. Yeah. Remember when D.D. played with? Sure. Remember when D.D. played with? Sure. Remember when D.D. played with? Sure. Remember when I played violin, when Frank had it? I remember that. Frank Duesen? Frank Duesen. Well, they had D.D. then. Yeah. And they had Frank Duesen. Even John Vien played with him, too. John Vien played with him after? After, yeah. And all the good…
And you remember the very first job you ever played with? Yes, yes, I do. What was that?
